title: PDF Conversion Services Samples
description: PDF conversion request templates, sample screenshots and a practical PDF-to-Word/Excel quality checklist for US, UK and Australian projects.
value: Scope a PDF conversion job before production: source format, target format, page count and layout priorities.
guide: State the source and target formats, estimate the page count, and describe how closely the converted output must match the source. Attach a representative source file through your chosen secure channel. This repository contains request templates and a QA checklist; it is not a conversion engine and does not demonstrate a completed PDF-to-Word or PDF-to-Excel conversion.
